title: The Signature Textbook Edition Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. ISBNs, authors, editions, publishers, and publication dates for every textbook. The Textbook Edition Database records textbook editions as distinct, comparable records: ISBN-10 and ISBN-13, authors, edition number, publisher, publication date, page count, and table of contents. Edition records map to courses that require them and flag which editions are interchangeable for problem sets. The Signature side adds chapter-mapping tables between consecutive editions so students with an older edition can follow along.
capabilities: Distinguish every textbook edition as its own comparable record
Map required textbooks to courses and sections
Flag edition changes that renumber problems or chapters
Match older editions to current ones with chapter crosswalks
Validate ISBNs with check-digit verification

title: The Signature Textbook Edition Database — Safety, limits, and ecosystem
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. ISBN records cover major academic publishers; self-published course packets may not appear. Crosswalks are best-effort between consecutive editions. Related databases: Open Textbook Database, College Course Catalog Database, Library Catalog Database.
